description: Close an open investigation with the team's reason, only when the user asks. Future investigations read the note. expected, wrong and not_useful keep the subject quiet for 30 days unless it gets materially worse.

investigationId.description: Investigation ID from list_investigations, list_insights (investigationId), or Slack.

reason.description: expected: the team knew or intended it. wrong: the analysis is not right. not_useful: real but not worth attention. already_fixed: fixed outside Databuddy.

name: dismiss_investigation
title: Dismiss investigation
